# SETUP AND LOAD LIBRARIES

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(randomcoloR) # For distinct color palettes
library(future) # For parallel processing
library(scales) # For proportion formatting
```

# LOAD ANNOTATED DATA

```{r}
INPUT_OBJECT_PATH <- "path/to/combined_marker_genes_annotated.rds"
SAVE_FINAL_OBJECT_PATH <- "path/to/combined_de_annotated_MAST.rds"
SAVE_ALL_MARKERS_PATH <- "path/to/cluster_markers_all.csv"
SAVE_UPREGULATED_MARKERS_PATH <- "path/to/cluster_markers_upregulated.csv"
SAVE_PLOTS_DIR <- "path/to/plots/"

if (!file.exists(INPUT_OBJECT_PATH)) {
  stop("ERROR: Input object not found. Ensure file path is correct.")
}
singlets <- readRDS(INPUT_OBJECT_PATH)

# Set SCT assay as default and identities to Seurat clusters for DGE
DefaultAssay(singlets) <- "SCT"
Idents(singlets) <- singlets$seurat_clusters

print(paste("Loaded object with", ncol(singlets), "nuclei."))
```

# DIFFERENTIAL GENE EXPRESSION

```{r}
# Configure parallel processing for faster marker finding (Adjust workers as needed)
plan("multicore", workers = 8) 
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000 * 1024^2) 

# Force re-correction for DE (required when using SCT after integration/clustering)
singlets <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(
  singlets,
  assay = "SCT",
  verbose = FALSE
)

# Run FindAllMarkers using MAST
cluster_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  singlets,
  assay = "SCT",
  slot = "data",
  min.pct = 0.5,
  logfc.threshold = 0.5, 
  only.pos = FALSE,
  test.use = "MAST",
    verbose = FALSE
)
```

# CLEAN AND SAVE MARKER RESULTS

```{r}
# Filter out mitochondrial genes 
cluster_markers <- cluster_markers[!grepl("^MT-", toupper(cluster_markers$gene)), ]

# Filter and save all significant markers (p_val_adj < 0.05)
cluster_markers_filtered <- cluster_markers %>%
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) 

write.csv(cluster_markers_filtered, SAVE_ALL_MARKERS_PATH, row.names = FALSE)
print(paste("Filtered cluster markers saved to:", SAVE_ALL_MARKERS_PATH))

# Extract and save strictly upregulated markers (for pathway analysis later)
upregulated <- cluster_markers_filtered %>%
 filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>% 
 group_by(cluster) %>%
 arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
 ungroup()

write.csv(upregulated, SAVE_UPREGULATED_MARKERS_PATH, row.names = FALSE)
print(paste("Upregulated markers saved to:", SAVE_UPREGULATED_MARKERS_PATH))

# Get top 5 genes for visualization
top5 <- upregulated %>%
 group_by(cluster) %>%
 arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
 slice_head(n = 5) %>%
 pull(gene) %>%
 unique()
```

# CELL TYPE ANNOTATION

```{r}
# Define the standardized annotation mapping table.
#    Replace the placeholders (e.g., "0", "Cell Type A", "Detailed Subtype A") 
#    with the corresponding values derived from your DGE analysis.
cluster_map_raw <- data.frame(
 Cluster = 0:24, # Ensure this list covers ALL your cluster IDs (e.g., 0, 1, 2, ...)
 DE_Annotation_broad = c(
  "Broad Cell Type A", "Broad Cell Type B", "Broad Cell Type C", # ... one for each cluster
  rep("...", 22) # Placeholder for remaining 22 cluster annotations
 ),
 DE_Annotation_detailed = c(
  "Detailed Subtype A (C0)", "Detailed Subtype B (C1)", "Detailed Subtype C (C2)", # ... one for each cluster
  rep("...", 22) # Placeholder for remaining 22 cluster detailed annotations
 ),
 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Define Order for Broad Groups.
pub_order_broad <- c(
    "Cardiomyocytes", "Fibroblasts", "Endothelial Cells", # ... include all broad names
    "Macrophages", "Uncharacterized" # ... in your desired display order
)

# Apply the mapping and ordering to Seurat metadata.
cluster_map_final <- cluster_map_raw %>%
    # Factor the broad annotation according to the fixed publication order
    mutate(DE_Annotation_broad = factor(DE_Annotation_broad, levels = pub_order_broad)) 

# Add the new, standardized annotation columns to the Seurat object
singlets$DE_Annotation_broad <- cluster_map_final$DE_Annotation_broad[match(singlets$seurat_clusters, cluster_map_final$Cluster)]
singlets$DE_Annotation_detailed <- cluster_map_final$DE_Annotation_detailed[match(singlets$seurat_clusters, cluster_map_final$Cluster)]

# Create the combined label for UMAP visualization (e.g., "Detailed Subtype A (C0)")
singlets$Cluster_Anno_Label <- paste0(
 as.character(singlets$DE_Annotation_detailed),
 " (C", 
 as.character(singlets$seurat_clusters),
 ")"
)
Idents(singlets) <- singlets$Cluster_Anno_Label
```

# VISUALIZATIONS

## UMAP with Detailed Annotations

```{r}
# Generate distinct colors for detailed annotations
n_detailed <- length(unique(singlets$Cluster_Anno_Label))
colors_detailed <- distinctColorPalette(n_detailed)
names(colors_detailed) <- unique(singlets$Cluster_Anno_Label)

# Prepare cluster centers for adding cluster numbers
umap_coords <- Embeddings(singlets, "umap")
cluster_ids_num <- as.character(singlets$seurat_clusters) 
centers <- aggregate(umap_coords, by = list(cluster = cluster_ids_num), FUN = mean)
colnames(centers)[2:3] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

# Plot
p1 <- DimPlot(
 singlets,
 group.by = "Cluster_Anno_Label",
 repel = TRUE, raster = FALSE, pt.size = 0.5
) +
 scale_color_manual(values = colors_detailed) +
 guides(color = guide_legend(ncol=1, override.aes = list(size=3))) + 
 labs(title = "UMAP: Detailed Cell Type Annotations") +
 theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
 theme(legend.title = element_blank())

# Add cluster numbers as text labels on UMAP
p1 <- p1 +
 geom_text(
  data = centers,
  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = cluster),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  color = "black",
  size = 4,
  fontface = "bold"
 )
print(p1)
ggsave(paste0(SAVE_PLOTS_DIR, "celltype_detailed_umap.png"), p1, width = 16, height = 9)
```

## UMAP Split by Genotype

```{r}
p_split <- DimPlot(
 singlets,
 group.by = "Cluster_Anno_Label",
 split.by = "Genotype", # Assumes a metadata column named 'Genotype' exists
 repel = TRUE, raster = FALSE, pt.size = 0.5
) +
 scale_color_manual(values = colors_detailed) +
 guides(color = guide_legend(ncol=1, override.aes = list(size=3))) +
 labs(title = "UMAP: Detailed Cell Type Annotation Split by Genotype") +
 theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
 theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_blank())

# Add cluster numbers
p_split <- p_split +
 geom_text(
  data = centers,
  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = cluster),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  color = "black",
  size = 4,
  fontface = "bold"
 )
print(p_split)

ggsave(
 paste0(SAVE_PLOTS_DIR, "celltype_detailed_umap_split_by_Genotype.png"),
 p_split,
 width = 18,
 height = 8
)
```

## DotPlot of Top Markers

```{r}
# Re-set Idents to detailed cell type names for the DotPlot visualization
Idents(singlets) <- singlets$DE_Annotation_detailed

p_cluster <- DotPlot(singlets, features = top5, cols = c("lightgrey", "red"), dot.scale = 8) +
 RotatedAxis() +
 labs(size = "Avg Expression Scale", color = "Percent Expressed") +
 ggtitle("Top 5 Upregulated Markers per Cluster (Grouped by Detailed Annotation)") +
 theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
print(p_cluster)
ggsave(paste0(SAVE_PLOTS_DIR, "dotplot_DE_celltype.png"), p_cluster, width = 24, height = 10)
```

## Bar Plot: Broad Cell Type Proportions by Genotype

```{r}
bar_df <- singlets@meta.data %>%
 group_by(Genotype, DE_Annotation_broad) %>%
 summarise(cell_count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
 group_by(Genotype) %>%
 mutate(proportion = cell_count / sum(cell_count)) %>%
 ungroup() %>%
  # Ensure the broad groups are ordered correctly
  mutate(DE_Annotation_broad = factor(DE_Annotation_broad, levels = pub_order_broad))

p2 <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = DE_Annotation_broad, y = proportion, fill = Genotype)) +
 geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
 # Use proportion labels formatted as percentage
 geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 0.1)),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
      vjust = -0.2,
      size = 3) +
 theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
 labs(x = "Cell Type (Broad Annotation)", y = "Proportion of Total Nuclei", fill = "Genotype") +
 ggtitle("Genotype-wise Cell Type Distribution") +
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
        legend.position = "bottom")
print(p2)
ggsave(paste0(SAVE_PLOTS_DIR, "bar_celltype_genotype_broad.png"), p2, width = 14, height = 8)
```

# SAVE FINAL ANNOTATED OBJECT

```{r}
saveRDS(singlets, SAVE_FINAL_OBJECT_PATH)
print(paste("Final DGE-annotated object saved to:", SAVE_FINAL_OBJECT_PATH))
```
